# Aadesh Kumar

## Overview
Aadesh Kumar is an AI automation engineer and full-stack developer based in India. He designs AI agent workflows and multi-model LLM pipelines with n8n, and builds production web platforms with Next.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL and Prisma. At CIS IT Solutions he has been the sole developer across five production SaaS products, and he independently builds and operates two live automated platforms of his own.

## Live products built by Aadesh Kumar
- Decoded Person (https://decodedperson.com) — an autonomous tech-news platform. Twenty RSS sources feed an LLM triage step, followed by full-text scraping, a fact-validation agent and a quality gate before publishing, with deduplication against PostgreSQL at every stage. One orchestrated workflow distributes each story to YouTube, Instagram, LinkedIn and Discord. Reached an average Google position of 8.1 in its first week live.
- Japp Tattva (https://japptattva.com) — an e-commerce storefront, admin backend and headless blog platform in a single monorepo, with Redis caching, cron jobs and payment integration. Its 109-node content pipeline handles research, writing, auditing, SEO and publishing with automatic fallback across GPT, Gemini and Llama models.

## Services and expertise
- AI agent development and workflow automation with n8n
- Multi-model LLM pipelines with fallback and structured output parsing
- Full-stack product development with Next.js, React and TypeScript
- Backend and API development with Node.js and Express
- Multi-tenant SaaS architecture, PostgreSQL and Prisma, Redis caching
- Authentication with NextAuth / Auth.js, OAuth 2.0 and JWT
- Load and performance testing with K6 and Grafana
- Automated SEO: Google Search Console integration, IndexNow, Schema.org
